description: Endpoint operators and buyers can check one listed L402 endpoint by passing its id from the newest Agent Payments Index probe file. One live request gives the buyer a private result with the current status, the challenge and invoice amount, and the last daily result for comparison. An endpoint timeout or error is charged. Rate limits are checked before an invoice is issued, but a paid call can still be refused later. If the failure is ours, your Lightning payment has already settled and there is no automatic refund. The macaroon and invoice string are never returned and results are not published. Price: 21 sats per call.

id.description: Endpoint id from the newest Agent Payments Index probe file, listed at https://loopxxi.com/agent-payments-index/hosts.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 21 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

name: l402_recheck
